quickSupport.title: Need a moment?
quickSupport.description: You can start with one small action right now — no questionnaire or score needed.
quickSupport.groundingPrompt: Notice your feet resting on the ground. Look around and quietly name three things you can see. Breathe at a pace that feels comfortable.
quickSupport.optionalNote: This is an optional self-support exercise, not a diagnosis or prediction.

observations.general: You checked in with your mood. If you wish, you can choose one small action.

suggestions.breathing: You could try a short breathing exercise at a comfortable pace. It's an option, not a requirement.
suggestions.calming: If you'd like a pause, you can choose one of the calming exercises. It's entirely optional.

nextStep.limitNote: This suggestion follows a simple rule based on one self-reported check-in. It is not a forecast, diagnosis, or risk assessment. We cannot know which action will help you.
